4 carat cushion cut diamonds are a popular choice for a statement engagement ring.

4 carat cushion cut diamond price

As a broad range, the cost of a 4 carat cushion cut diamond can vary from $22,000 to $180,000 at the time this article was written.

4 carat cushion cut diamond size

A typical 4 carat cushion cut diamond may be around 9.15mm × 9.15mm × 5.90mm.

4 carat cushion cut diamond color

I color diamonds are a great balance of whiteness and value for money at this carat weight.

4 carat cushion cut diamond clarity

A good starting point for 4 carat cushion cut diamond clarity is SI1.

Solitaire settings are a great match for cushion cut diamonds.
